provenance.method: Pedigree simulation: Poisson crossovers (Haldane, no interference) on the sex-averaged HapMap II GRCh37 map; founders carry distinct haplotypes; shared regions merged into segments; segments and fully identical runs under the threshold are not counted.
references: Caballero M, Seidman DN, Qiao Y, Sannerud J, Dyer TD, Lehman DM, Curran JE, Duggirala R, Blangero J, Carmi S, Williams AL (2019). Crossover interference and sex-specific genetic maps shape identical by descent sharing in close relatives. PLoS Genet 15(12):e1007979. PMID 31860654

Huff CD, Witherspoon DJ, Simonson TS, Xing J, Watkins WS, Zhang Y, Tuohy TM, Neklason DW, Burt RW, Guthery SL, Woodward SR, Jorde LB (2011). Maximum-likelihood estimation of recent shared ancestry (ERSA). Genome Res 21(5):768-774. PMID 21324875
